name: Codeigni8 CPT to Product Converter for WooCommerce
author: codeigni8

sections.description:
Codeigni8 CPT to Product Converter for WooCommerce lets you convert any WordPress Custom Post Type (CPT) into WooCommerce products without touching your original data.

Perfect for migrating directories, catalogs, listings, or inventory stored as Custom Post Types into WooCommerce.

Why use this plugin?

Many WordPress sites store products, listings, or inventory inside Custom Post Types. This plugin allows you to convert those entries into WooCommerce products without manually recreating them.

Perfect for:

  • Migrating directories or listings into WooCommerce
  • Turning blog-style content into products
  • Migrating from custom-built stores into WooCommerce
  • Bulk converting CPT-based catalogs into WooCommerce

Key features:
* Auto-detect all public Custom Post Types registered on your site.
* Flexible field mapping for title, content, and excerpt.
* Featured image from the original post is copied automatically.
* Batch conversion to convert all posts of a CPT in one click.
* Product status control (draft or published).
* Preview mapping before running the conversion.
* Conversion tracking showing how many products were created.
* No data loss — original posts are never modified or deleted.

Requirements:

  • WordPress 6.0 or higher
  • WooCommerce 6.0 or higher
  • PHP 7.4 or higher

Support

If you encounter issues or have feature requests, please open a support thread in the WordPress.org plugin support forum.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the codeigni8-cpt-to-product-converter-for-woocommerce folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install directly through the WordPress plugin screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to Codeigni8 → CPT Converter in the WordPress admin menu.
  4. Your public custom post types will be detected automatically.
  5. Click Create Mapping next to a post type to set up field mappings.
  6. Click Convert Now to run the batch conversion.
sections.faq:
Does the plugin delete my original posts?

No. The plugin only creates WooCommerce products from your selected Custom Post Type entries. Your original posts remain unchanged.

Can I undo a conversion?

Currently the plugin does not include an automatic rollback feature. Converted products can be removed from the WooCommerce Products screen.

Will existing WooCommerce products be affected?

No. The plugin only creates new WooCommerce products from your Custom Post Type entries. Existing products are never modified.

Which WooCommerce version is required?

The plugin works with WooCommerce 6.0 or higher.

What happens if I run a conversion twice?

Running the conversion multiple times will create duplicate products. If this happens, duplicates can be removed from the WooCommerce Products screen.

Which Custom Post Types are supported?

Any public Custom Post Type can be converted into WooCommerce products.

Does the plugin support taxonomy terms?

Not in the current version. Taxonomy mapping is planned for a future update.

Can I map custom fields?

Basic meta mapping is supported programmatically. A visual interface for mapping custom fields is planned for a future version.
sections.changelog:
1.0.0

  • Initial release.
  • Auto-detection of public custom post types.
  • Basic field mapping (title, content, excerpt, featured image).
  • Batch conversion with draft/publish status selection.
  • Conversion tracking – the dashboard shows how many products were created per post type.
  • No data loss – source posts are never modified or deleted.
